response.sql: WITH customer_totals AS (SELECT SUM(Total) as customer_total FROM Invoice GROUP BY CustomerId), overall_stats AS (SELECT SUM(customer_total) as overall_sum, COUNT(*) as customer_count FROM customer_totals), shares_with_threshold AS (SELECT ct.customer_total, ct.customer_total / os.overall_sum as share, 1.0 / os.customer_count as avg_threshold FROM customer_totals ct CROSS JOIN overall_stats os), above_average AS (SELECT * FROM shares_with_threshold WHERE share > avg_threshold) SELECT AVG(customer_total) as avg_amount_spent, AVG(share) as avg_share, AVG(share) - (SELECT 1.0 / customer_count FROM overall_stats) as avg_share_beat FROM above_average;
